category_title: Year 11 pupils who are demotivated by public reprimands and prioritize task-based feedback over behavioral rewards
minimal_context: The student is working on classroom tasks to achieve overall success.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please focus on your classroom tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm looking at my grades. Getting low marks is the greatest motivator to work hard for my overall success.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop talking. I am telling you off in front of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Being told off in front of the class is demotivating in relation to working hard. Public criticism of behaviour just makes me do less work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you don't get back to work, you will be made to miss break.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Switches off completely) Being made to miss break just makes me dislike the teacher. I'm going to mess about and do less work now.
